model_annotation: Figure 3, titled “Разходи за НИРД и иновации (в хил.лв.) по някои сектори на националната икономика за петгодишен период” (Expenditures for R&D and innovations (in thousand levs) by selected sectors of the national economy over a five-year period), is intended to illustrate the magnitude and distribution of R&D and innovation expenditures across different economic sectors during a specified five-year timeframe. The horizontal axis (X-axis) represents the time period, labeled as “петгодишен период” (five-year period), and is divided into five discrete intervals, each corresponding to a single year, though the specific calendar years are not labeled. The vertical axis (Y-axis) quantifies the expenditures in “хил.лв.” (thousand levs), with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, marked at intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100). The figure contains multiple line plots, each representing a different economic sector. All lines are solid and colored differently for distinction, though the specific color assignments and sector labels are not legible in the provided image. Visually, each line traces the annual expenditure for its respective sector: some lines begin at low values and show a steady increase over the five years, others remain relatively flat with minor fluctuations, and a few exhibit a sharp rise in the final year. The lines do not intersect, and their relative positions indicate that certain sectors consistently maintain higher expenditure levels than others throughout the period. The source of the data is cited as “НСИ” (National Statistical Institute).
